title: Audit report
description: Input for spectre audit build. One JSON file per report. Text fields are plain text: HTML is escaped, and `backticks` become <code>. A backticked repo path with a line (`src/a.ts:12` or `src/a.ts:12-20`) becomes an editor link.

reportId.description: Stable standalone feedback identity. Preserve it across edits; assign a new value for a separate report.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor completion.

title.description: Page title and H1, e.g. "Flightline Codebase Audit".

project.description: Short project name shown in the header meta line.

repoRoot.description: Absolute POSIX path of the repo on the reader's machine, e.g. /mnt/c/git/vcsg8/flightline. Every finding path is relative to this. Editor links are built from it.

wslDistro.description: WSL distro name for the VS Code / Cursor WSL links. Default: $WSL_DISTRO_NAME at build time, else "Ubuntu".

stamp.description: Small boxed label above the title. Default "Discrepancy log".

scope.description: What was looked at, how (read-only? live?), and what was left out.

areas.description: Sections of the report, in display order.

key.description: Short id used by findings[].area, e.g. "sec".

fixFirst.description: Finding ids in the order to fix them. An item can be an id string, or {id, why} to give a one-line reason (else the summary is shown).

openQuestions.description: Questions only the owner can answer. A string, or {text, findingId} to link a finding.

clean.description: What was checked and found fine. Tells the reader what not to worry about.

area.description: An area key (shown as its name) or free text.

notes.description: Footer text: where the raw notes are, what could not be checked.

relPath.description: Path relative to repoRoot, forward slashes, no "..".

endLine.description: Last line of a range. Must be >= line. Links open at line.

oneOf.description: A place in the code. Give an excerpt, a note, or both.

excerpt.description: Short code excerpt, copied exactly (15 lines or fewer). Shown as a code block. '...' for cut lines is fine.

note.description: One sentence: what this line shows.

path.description: Relative to the report JSON file (not repoRoot).

caption.description: What the image shows. Also used as alt text.

oneOf.description: A command you ran and what it printed.

output.description: Exact output, trimmed to the part that matters. Empty string means no output.

note.description: One sentence: what the output proves.

coa.description: A course of action: one real way to respond.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the finding, e.g. "do-nothing". Reader decisions are saved against it, so keep it when you reorder or reword. If missing, the build uses coa-1, coa-2... by position and warns.

name.description: Short name, e.g. "Check the limit before the transaction" or "Do nothing".

description.description: What you would do, in plain words.

effort.description: S: hours. M: a day or two. L: a week or more, or needs other people.

risk.description: Risk of doing this option (for "Do nothing": risk of leaving it).

touches.description: Files this option changes: "path", "path:line" or "path:line-end", relative to repoRoot.

recommended.description: At most one COA per finding. More than one fails the build.

recommendedReason.description: Required when recommended is true. One sentence.

id.description: Unique id, e.g. "SEC-03". Also names the feedback record feedback/<id>, so only letters, digits and _ - . ~ : @ +.

status.description: Summary counts show open findings. Closed ones stay listed and are marked.

statusNote.description: e.g. "Fixed in migration 0114" or who accepted the risk and why.

title.description: What is wrong, as a plain statement.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences: what is wrong and who it hurts.

evidence.description: Verified proof. The build warns when empty.

current.description: How it is now, told fairly. For fixed findings, describe the state the audit found.

pros.description: Real reasons the current design exists.

coas.description: 2-4 genuinely different options. The build warns outside that range.
